name: Mi-Memory
ontology_notes: Personal-AI lifecycle, not companion kinds. Structure stores L0 atomic facts, L1 session/topic summaries, L2 profile and corrections, SM session memory. Expansion adds PerceptionFact/IKB image rows and MemFuse FusedEvent/MemoryPack payloads. Evolution uses DiagnosticSignal and StrategyArtifact plus gate/rollback records. LiteMem maps those layers onto Markdown files (user/profile.md, entity/*.md, daily logs) with Git provenance. No character autobiography, relationship phase, lore vs lived event, or OOC type.

ontology.evidence: Paper Table 4 and §4.2. Typed layers L0/L1/L2/SM plus FusedEvent, PerceptionFact, ProcedureEntry. Granularity and source types for one user. Not user vs character vs relationship vs lore vs OOC.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Write operator W in §4.2 may create, summarize, promote, or invalidate. Adapters extract dialogue. MemSense and MemFuse admit images and device events as typed payloads. User corrections enter L2. No joke or hypothetical refusal. Repo Darwin-Agent/Mi-Memory is an intro page, not the runtime.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Serving selects E_qt then packs C_qt then generates a_t (§3.1). Hybrid R_sem, R_lex, R_exp fused by RRF (Eq. 10). Table 20 reserves forget/update constraints and L2 before packing L0/L1. Overflow traces on drop. No trauma skip of a high-score hit.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: L1 has summary lineage and supersession links (Table 4). U can invalidate. L2 keeps profile diffs and correction history. LiteMem Git diffs mark which earlier statement a correction superseded (§7.2).
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Every admitted observation keeps temporal order (§4.2). QA prompt requires timestamps and phrases such as every Tuesday. LiteMem Score uses recency exp(-dt/tau) (Eq. 8).
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: One Personal-AI user. LiteMem Appendix G splits user/profile.md from entity/ethan.md and session files. Ethan is a family entity in the running example, not a companion character or relationship-phase type.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Related work names retrieval in the wrong situation as a known risk (§2). The runtime has no trauma, kink, or spoiler skip. Assembly ranks by fused score after reserved constraints (Table 20).
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Provenance, gates, and rollback exist. §8.2 says deletion propagation, cross-user leakage, and memory poisoning need platform ACL and adversarial validation beyond the reported evidence. No trust tag that blocks chat extract from overwriting persona.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: Forget/update constraints are mandatory packing slots (Table 20). U can decay or invalidate. §9 says current forget-guards do not stop a revoked fact from influencing summaries, profiles, or caches. Hole 9 remains open.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Hybrid retrieve plus optional rerank and LLM subquery expansion, then budgeted assembly B. Table 12. MemStack LoCoMo 93.59% at high infra cost. LiteMem 90.81% local Markdown/Git, no vector DB.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: LICENSE MIT, Darwin Agent Team Xiaomi 2026. LiteMem is a local Markdown/Git transfer probe (§7). Public repo ships index.html, paper.pdf, MemFuse PDF, not MemStack. Intimate chat can stay local only if you reimplement LiteMem.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: No MCP server in the paper, homepage, or Darwin-Agent/Mi-Memory tree (README says introduction page).
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Closest recent Personal-AI framing. Typed layers, provenance, gates, and rollback are real. Serving is still select-evidence then speak. LoCoMo, PersonaMem-v2, and LongMemEval score assistant fact and preference QA, not companion silence, identity drift, or typed writers. Public repo is not a runnable engine.

published_eval.name: MemStack controlled-reference vs reproduced MemBrain on LoCoMo, PersonaMem-V2, LongMemEval (GPT-4.1-mini, EverMemOS harness)
published_eval.claimed_score: LoCoMo 93.59%, PersonaMem-V2 57.24%, LongMemEval 87.47% (§8.1, homepage, README Results). E2MEND LoCoMo offline 75.58% to 94.74%. LiteMem LoCoMo-aligned 90.81% (90.0% retention vs no-memory 65.83%). Mem-Gallery 89.15%. MemFuseBench 35.2% preliminary.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: LoCoMo is two-speaker friend-chat fact QA. PersonaMem-v2 is user-preference personalization, including update and ask_to_forget probes, not character identity. LongMemEval is assistant haystack fact QA. None score social silence, poisoning of persona, or user-retcon vs character-lie vs narrator.
published_eval.source: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.18975 §4.3 Figure 4 and §8.1; https://darwin-agent.github.io/Mi-Memory/; https://github.com/Darwin-Agent/Mi-Memory README Results

open_unknowns: MemStack, D2ACCI, E2MEND, and LiteMem runtimes are not in the public tree. File and symbol names for W, R_sem, and the gate record come from the paper, not shipped code.
Whether PersonaMem-v2 forget constraints delete derived L1/L2 rows on the next turn, or only reserve a packing slot.
